mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP, parse its text (PDF/Word), and convert it into a structured tabular format capturing sections, subsections, and key clauses. Store the result as a JSON or CSV for downstream analysis.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: Structured representation of the RFP document (e.g., JSON with section titles and clause texts).

units.description: From the structured RFP, identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Classify each criterion by category and capture any referenced standards or regulations.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A list of mandatory technical criteria with metadata (category, source clause, regulatory reference).

units.task_name: Model Multi‑Tier Labor Pricing & Generate Executive Proposal
units.description: Using the extracted criteria, build a tiered labor pricing model (e.g., Tier 1: core migration, Tier 2: security hardening, Tier 3: ongoing support). Compute unit costs and total project cost. Then produce an executive proposal that includes a compliance traceability matrix linking each requirement to its solution component and associated price.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A formatted executive proposal document (e.g., Markdown or PDF) containing the pricing model, compliance traceability matrix, and narrative justification.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP, including extraction of mandatory technical compliance criteria, modeling of multi‑tier labor pricing, and generation of a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires three distinct phases: ingesting the uploaded RFP document, extracting and structuring the mandatory technical requirements, building a tiered labor cost model, and finally synthesizing an executive proposal that links each requirement to its corresponding solution and pricing. Each phase is independent enough to be executed sequentially but must rely on the output of the previous step.
